layout_note: Full FSE 2025 QSF artifact (https://github.com/zbchen/QSF). Benchmarks are pre-filtered per the paper: 266 SMT-COMP QF_FP instances and 3493 GSL/KLEE real-world program instances.
copy_note: The shared package is read-only. Copy selected .smt2 instances or smt-runner scripts into project/ before modifying or writing solver outputs.

instance_counts.note: Counts verified by download_qsf_dataset.sh against paper Section 4.3.1

python_environment.note: Prepared automatically at container startup. System z3/clang/llvm also available on PATH.

not_provided.baseline_solvers: Paper baselines (Z3, Bitwuzla, goSAT, JFS, etc.) are not preinstalled. Install or implement comparison methods as needed.
not_provided.klee_symbolic_execution: KLEE+GSL branch-coverage experiments are optional; standalone benchmark solving uses the provided .smt2 files.
